name: brandspace
description: BrandSpace — bilingual multi-tenant AI brand and social media operating system

scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm gate:isolation && pnpm test
scripts.e2e:build: pnpm --filter @brandspace/web build && pnpm --filter @brandspace/dashboard build && pnpm --filter @brandspace/admin build
scripts.verify:all: pnpm verify && pnpm e2e:build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.db:roles: echo "Run: psql -v migrator_password=... -v app_password=... -v platform_password=... -f scripts/sql/setup-database-roles.sql"
scripts.e2e:seed: tsx tests/e2e/seed-admin.ts && tsx tests/e2e/seed-ai.ts && tsx tests/e2e/seed-quotas.ts && tsx tests/e2e/seed-visual.ts && tsx tests/e2e/seed-content.ts && tsx tests/e2e/seed-social.ts && tsx tests/e2e/seed-analytics.ts && tsx tests/e2e/seed-commerce.ts
scripts.e2e:screenshots: BRANDSPACE_VISUAL_REVIEW=1 pnpm e2e:seed && BRANDSPACE_VISUAL_REVIEW=1 playwright test --project=visual-review
